title: Fleet Overview - All Instances
description: The Data Eyes UI (Fleet, Instance, Alerts, Collector) on the Data Eyes Prometheus.

panels.title: Fleet status
panels.description: Worst status across the selected instances. An unreachable server counts as Unknown.

targets.expr: max(max by (sql_instance) (data_eyes_overall_severity{environment=~"$environment"}) * on (sql_instance) max by (sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"$environment"}) + on (sql_instance) (1 - max by (sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"$environment"})))

count((max by (sql_instance) (data_eyes_overall_severity{environment=~"$environment"}) * on (sql_instance) max by (sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"$environment"}) + on (sql_instance) (1 - max by (sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"$environment"}))) == 3) or vector(0)

count((max by (sql_instance) (data_eyes_overall_severity{environment=~"$environment"}) * on (sql_instance) max by (sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"$environment"}) + on (sql_instance) (1 - max by (sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"$environment"}))) == 2) or vector(0)

count((max by (sql_instance) (data_eyes_overall_severity{environment=~"$environment"}) * on (sql_instance) max by (sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"$environment"}) + on (sql_instance) (1 - max by (sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"$environment"}))) == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Unknown
panels.description: Unreachable, or no result yet.

targets.expr: count((max by (sql_instance) (data_eyes_overall_severity{environment=~"$environment"}) * on (sql_instance) max by (sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"$environment"}) + on (sql_instance) (1 - max by (sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"$environment"}))) == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Health by category
panels.description: Worst check in each alert group across the selected instances (the Fleet page's summary tiles).

targets.expr: max by (group) (max by (sql_instance, group) (label_replace(data_eyes_health_severity{environment=~"$environment"}, "check", "$1", "category", "alert\\.(.+)") * on (check) group_left (group) data_eyes_check_info))

panels.title: Instances
panels.description: One row per instance, as on the Fleet page. AV BK ST TD PF MT SC = worst check in Availability, Backup & integrity, Storage, Tempdb, Performance, Maintenance, Configuration & security. ALERTS = number of categories at Warning or Critical. Click a name to open it in the Instance section.

targets.expr: max by (sql_instance) (data_eyes_overall_severity{environment=~"$environment"}) * on (sql_instance) max by (sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"$environment"}) + on (sql_instance) (1 - max by (sql_instance) (data_eyes_sqlserver_reachable{environment=~"$environment"}))

count by (sql_instance) (max by (sql_instance, group) (label_replace(data_eyes_health_severity{environment=~"$environment"}, "check", "$1", "category", "alert\\.(.+)") * on (check) group_left (group) data_eyes_check_info) >= 2) or on (sql_instance) (0 * max by (sql_instance) (data_eyes_instance_info{environment=~"$environment"}))

max by (sql_instance) (max by (sql_instance, group) (label_replace(data_eyes_health_severity{environment=~"$environment"}, "check", "$1", "category", "alert\\.(.+)") * on (check) group_left (group) data_eyes_check_info{group="Availability"}))

max by (sql_instance) (max by (sql_instance, group) (label_replace(data_eyes_health_severity{environment=~"$environment"}, "check", "$1", "category", "alert\\.(.+)") * on (check) group_left (group) data_eyes_check_info{group="Backup & integrity"}))

max by (sql_instance) (max by (sql_instance, group) (label_replace(data_eyes_health_severity{environment=~"$environment"}, "check", "$1", "category", "alert\\.(.+)") * on (check) group_left (group) data_eyes_check_info{group="Storage"}))

max by (sql_instance) (max by (sql_instance, group) (label_replace(data_eyes_health_severity{environment=~"$environment"}, "check", "$1", "category", "alert\\.(.+)") * on (check) group_left (group) data_eyes_check_info{group="Tempdb"}))

max by (sql_instance) (max by (sql_instance, group) (label_replace(data_eyes_health_severity{environment=~"$environment"}, "check", "$1", "category", "alert\\.(.+)") * on (check) group_left (group) data_eyes_check_info{group="Performance"}))

max by (sql_instance) (max by (sql_instance, group) (label_replace(data_eyes_health_severity{environment=~"$environment"}, "check", "$1", "category", "alert\\.(.+)") * on (check) group_left (group) data_eyes_check_info{group="Maintenance"}))

max by (sql_instance) (max by (sql_instance, group) (label_replace(data_eyes_health_severity{environment=~"$environment"}, "check", "$1", "category", "alert\\.(.+)") * on (check) group_left (group) data_eyes_check_info{group="Configuration & security"}))

panels.title: Wait time · 24h
panels.description: Seconds of wait per second (5-minute rate), the Fleet page's WAIT · 24H column. An idle server is near 0.

panels.title: Always On and read-only databases
panels.description: The Fleet page's replica tags: databases in an availability group or read-only. Instances without any have no Always On databases.

targets.expr: max by (sql_instance, database, availability_group, replica_role, updateability) (data_eyes_database_info{environment=~"$environment", availability_group!=""}) or max by (sql_instance, database, availability_group, replica_role, updateability) (data_eyes_database_info{environment=~"$environment", updateability="READ_ONLY"})

panels.title: Blocking · Jobs · Errors
panels.description: The instance cards' health dots. Event checks (failed jobs, database errors) count as Warning when they fired in the last 24 hours.

targets.expr: max by (sql_instance) (data_eyes_health_severity{environment=~"$environment", category="alert.database_errors"} or 2 * (sum by (sql_instance) (increase(data_eyes_check_events_total{environment=~"$environment", check="database_errors"}[24h])) > 0))

panels.title: SQL memory vs target
panels.description: SQL Server memory in use as a share of its target. On SQL Server on Linux the in-use figure can exceed physical memory.

panels.title: Available memory
panels.description: Free physical memory on the host. Colors follow the Memory Available check defaults (Warning < 2 GB, Critical < 512 MB).

panels.title: Disk free
panels.description: Free space per volume. Colors follow the Disk Space check defaults (Warning <= 20 GB, Critical <= 5 GB).

panels.title: I/O latency
panels.description: Average stall per I/O across the instance's database files.

targets.expr: max by (group) (max by (sql_instance, group) (label_replace(data_eyes_health_severity{sql_instance="$instance"}, "check", "$1", "category", "alert\\.(.+)") * on (check) group_left (group) data_eyes_check_info))

panels.title: Buffer cache hit
panels.description: Share of page requests served from memory.

panels.title: Page life expectancy
panels.description: Seconds a page stays in the buffer pool. The Page Life Expectancy check warns below 300 s.

panels.title: AG redo queue
panels.description: Worst log send / redo queue across this instance's AG databases. Empty when the instance has none.

panels.title: Databases
panels.description: Database state, access mode and Always On membership on this instance. Access mode does not describe the monitoring login's permissions.

panels.title: Checks not OK
panels.description: This instance's alert checks that are not OK. Thresholds are set in collector/checks.yaml.

targets.expr: label_join(max by (check, name, group) ((label_replace(data_eyes_health_severity{sql_instance="$instance"}, "check", "$1", "category", "alert\\.(.+)") > 0) * on (check) group_left (name, group) data_eyes_check_info), "key", "", "check")

label_join(1000 * max by (check) (label_replace(data_eyes_collection_last_success_timestamp_seconds{sql_instance="$instance", collector=~"alert\\..+"}, "check", "$1", "collector", "alert\\.(.+)")) and on (check) (max by (check) (label_replace(data_eyes_health_severity{sql_instance="$instance"}, "check", "$1", "category", "alert\\.(.+)")) > 0), "key", "", "check")

panels.title: Affected databases
panels.description: Databases each open check flags. A database without a value (for example, CHECKDB never run) shows 'never checked'.

targets.expr: label_join(max by (check, name, database) ((data_eyes_database_check_severity{sql_instance="$instance"} >= 2) * on (check) group_left (name) data_eyes_check_info), "key", "|", "check", "database")

panels.title: Top waits · per day
panels.description: Top-10 wait categories by wait time per day (Top activity → Waits).

panels.title: I/O stall by database · per day
panels.description: Top activity → Databases.

panels.title: I/O stall by file · per day
panels.description: Top activity → Files.

panels.title: I/O stall by drive · per day
panels.description: Top activity → Drives. Linux volumes have no drive letter and show as one series.

panels.title: Deadlocks · per day
panels.description: Top activity → Deadlocks.

targets.expr: count((((label_replace(data_eyes_health_severity{environment=~"$environment"}, "check", "$1", "category", "alert\\.(.+)") >= 1) unless on (sql_instance) (data_eyes_health_severity{category="alert.sql_server_connection"} == 3)) or (label_replace(data_eyes_health_severity{environment=~"$environment", category="alert.sql_server_connection"}, "check", "$1", "category", "alert\\.(.+)") >= 1)) == 3) or vector(0)

count((((label_replace(data_eyes_health_severity{environment=~"$environment"}, "check", "$1", "category", "alert\\.(.+)") >= 1) unless on (sql_instance) (data_eyes_health_severity{category="alert.sql_server_connection"} == 3)) or (label_replace(data_eyes_health_severity{environment=~"$environment", category="alert.sql_server_connection"}, "check", "$1", "category", "alert\\.(.+)") >= 1)) == 2) or vector(0)

count((((label_replace(data_eyes_health_severity{environment=~"$environment"}, "check", "$1", "category", "alert\\.(.+)") >= 1) unless on (sql_instance) (data_eyes_health_severity{category="alert.sql_server_connection"} == 3)) or (label_replace(data_eyes_health_severity{environment=~"$environment", category="alert.sql_server_connection"}, "check", "$1", "category", "alert\\.(.+)") >= 1)) == 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Unreachable
panels.description: Instances whose SQL Server Connection check is critical.

panels.title: Checks failing
panels.description: Checks that could not run, usually a missing permission.

panels.title: Events · 24 h
panels.description: Instance / event check / hour combinations with new occurrences in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Open alerts
panels.description: Every check at Unknown, Warning or Critical. While a server is unreachable only its connection check is listed.

targets.expr: label_join(max by (sql_instance, check, name, group) ((((label_replace(data_eyes_health_severity{environment=~"$environment"}, "check", "$1", "category", "alert\\.(.+)") >= 1) unless on (sql_instance) (data_eyes_health_severity{category="alert.sql_server_connection"} == 3)) or (label_replace(data_eyes_health_severity{environment=~"$environment", category="alert.sql_server_connection"}, "check", "$1", "category", "alert\\.(.+)") >= 1)) * on (check) group_left (name, group) data_eyes_check_info), "key", "|", "sql_instance", "check")

label_join(max by (sql_instance, check, name, database) ((data_eyes_database_check_severity{environment=~"$environment"} >= 2) * on (check) group_left (name) data_eyes_check_info), "key", "|", "sql_instance", "check", "database")

panels.title: Checks that could not run
panels.description: Grant the login the permission the check needs, or turn the check off in collector/checks.yaml. Empty is good.

panels.title: Events · per hour · 7 days
panels.description: New occurrences of event checks (restarts, failed jobs, new logins, config changes) per instance and hour (Alerts → Events).

panels.title: Events · last 7 days
panels.description: One row per instance, event check and hour with new occurrences.

panels.title: Alert check catalog
panels.description: Every check the collector runs. Defaults live in collector/app/alerts/catalog.py; overrides in collector/checks.yaml.

targets.expr: max by (group, name, check, kind, direction, unit) (data_eyes_check_info)

panels.title: Exporter
panels.description: Whether Prometheus is scraping the collector's /metrics.

panels.title: Groups failing
panels.description: Collection groups (metric groups and alert checks) whose last run failed.

panels.title: Collection groups
panels.description: Every collection group per instance: metric groups every 30 s (databases every 5 min); alert checks by tier (1 min, 5 min, 1 h, 24 h).
